name: PromptMe Studio
author: rdarvishzadeh

sections.description:
PromptMe Studio turns a simple photo of your product into a professional product shot, with a model (woman, man or child) or without one, in ready-made themes such as a white background, a podium or a custom scene.

  • “Create professional photo” button on the WooCommerce product edit screen and product list
  • Set a generated photo as the product image or add it to the product gallery with one click
  • Works without WooCommerce too: generated photos are saved to the Media Library
  • Edit a generated photo with a short instruction (“make the background darker”)
  • “My projects” page with every photo you have created

The plugin interface is in Persian (Farsi).

External service

This plugin is an interface to the “Product Studio” service of PromptMe (https://promptme.ir). Photos are generated on PromptMe servers, so a PromptMe account is required and the site must be connected to it. Each photo costs credits (coins) from that account. Credits are bought on the PromptMe website.

What is sent to PromptMe and when:

  • When you connect the site: the site address and site name.
  • When you create a photo: the product photos you choose for it, the product name and type, and your choices in the wizard.
  • On every request: the connection key of your site, so PromptMe knows which account it belongs to.

Generated photos are shown in the dashboard from PromptMe servers and copied to your Media Library when you save them. Before you connect, the plugin only asks PromptMe for the current sign-up gift (https://promptme.ir/api/plugin/info) to show it on the connect card; no data about your site is sent. Nothing is sent from the public pages of your site.

  • Service: https://promptme.ir/business
  • Terms of use: https://promptme.ir/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://promptme.ir/privacy

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open “استودیو محصول” (Product Studio) in the dashboard menu and click “Connect to PromptMe”. Log in (or sign up with your mobile number) and allow the connection.
  3. Create photos from the same page or from the “Create professional photo” button on any product.
sections.faq:
Do I need a PromptMe account?

Yes. Photos are generated on PromptMe servers and paid for with the credits of your account. If you do not have an account, you can sign up on the connection page.

Does it need WooCommerce?

No. Without WooCommerce the studio works from its own dashboard page and saves photos to the Media Library. With WooCommerce, you can open it from each product and set the result as the product image or gallery image.

Who can use the studio?

Shop managers (manage_woocommerce), or administrators if WooCommerce is not installed.

How do I disconnect my site?

Click “Disconnect” on the plugin page, or remove the site from “Connected sites” in your PromptMe account. Deleting the plugin also disconnects it. Photos already saved to your Media Library are kept.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • First release in the WordPress plugin directory.

1.2.1

  • Heading font displays correctly on sites with a Persian font plugin.
  • Model photos are shown in a portrait frame, cropped from the top.

1.2.0

  • Shows the connection gift credits on the “Connect” card and after connecting.

1.1.0

  • Separate tab for the order being created; generation continues while you use other tabs.
  • New design with the Vazirmatn font.
  • Product notes field and a cost summary before generating.
  • Photo retention warning and remaining days for each project.

1.0.0

  • First version: account connection, photo wizard with and without a model, saving to the Media Library and WooCommerce products.
